issue.title: Write the retention policy for archived handbook pages
issue.description:
Archived handbook pages stay in the index forever, so a search for "expenses" still returns the 2023 policy above the current one.

We need a written rule for how long an archived page stays searchable and what happens to it after that.

nodes.body: Legal wants two years for anything that was ever a published policy. Everything else can drop out of search after ninety days.
Ninety days works for the index. Deleting the page itself is a separate decision and I would rather not bundle them.
